colour.reasoning: Temperature first: all three observers report golden-brown highlights and warm brown shadows under the jaw and neck that read 'not grey' in neutral daylight, so I read the undertone as warm. The slight cool cast from the walls would, if anything, understate that warmth, and silver that 'does not clash' only nudges her toward neutral-warm. Clarity is clear because the saturated magenta (#C21E6A) 'sits clearly' without making her look sallow and the silver reads crisp, so warm plus clear gives a bright spring with medium skin and very deep hair. On contrast, two observers said medium and one said high; I followed observer 1, whose undertone notes were the most specific, and placed contrast at medium-leaning-high, consistent with medium skin against black hair and dark brown eyes. The close alternative is deep winter if her undertone is truly neutral. The analysts split on warm versus cool, so the undertone is recorded as neutral.

skin.undertone_evidence: Golden-brown highlights on the forehead, cheeks and collarbone in neutral daylight. The shadows under the jaw and at the neck read warm brown, not grey. The skin sits clearly against the bright magenta blouse without looking sallow. Lips are a rosy brown. She wears silver-toned jewellery (hoops, fine necklace, rings), which reads cleanly on her but does not clash, so she may sit close to neutral-warm.

Choose high-shine silver for everyday hoops and rings, and polished yellow gold for festive and bridal jewellery, where it picks up the golden warmth in your skin. Skip oxidised, antiqued or brushed matte finishes; they look dull next to clear colour.

decisions.must_axis_why: Clear, saturated colour is what makes your skin glow. Magenta silk and bright silver both sit crisply on you. Dusty, greyed or muddy shades flatten you whatever their temperature, so clarity is the one rule you cannot bend.
decisions.flexible_axis_why: Your undertone sits between warm and cool. That means you can move from warm brights like coral and marigold into cooler jewel tones like sapphire, crimson and aubergine, as long as the colour stays clear. This is how you shop beyond the fan without going wrong.

avoid.name: Dusty mauve
avoid.why: Greyed pinks drain the golden-brown in your skin and make the shadows along your jaw look ashy

avoid.name: Muted olive khaki
avoid.why: Muddy greens pull your skin toward sallow and take the light out of your dark eyes

avoid.name: Greige taupe
avoid.why: Near your face it is too soft against your black hair, so your colouring looks washed out rather than vivid

decisions.changing_room_test: Take the fabric to a window and hold it right under your chin. If the shadows under your jaw stay warm brown and your eyes and brows look sharper, buy it. If your skin looks dusty or greyish, or the colour arrives before your face does, put it back.
decisions.archetype_why: You pair a soft, draping silk shirt, tucked in loosely, with sharply pressed wide-leg trousers and pointed boots. That is tailoring worn relaxed, with one hand in the pocket and nothing stiff about it. It is polish that looks effortless.
decisions.style_words_why: Polished: you already wear pressed creases, a neat tuck and pointed-toe boots. Breezy: in a hot, humid climate, the next step is the same shapes in linen-blends, cotton silk and light crepe that breathe through an office day and a wedding season. Joyful: your wide smile and bright magenta show that colour is where you look most yourself, so every piece should earn its place by lighting you up.

working.claim: Bright, clear colour at your face is already your strongest move. The magenta silk makes your skin look golden and alive.
working.evidence: All three records: bright magenta blouse (#C21E6A / #C2185B / #C2266E) 'sits clearly against' the skin 'without looking sallow' or 'grey or ashy' in neutral daylight.
working.why: Saturated, clear colour near the face is the core of a bright spring palette, and you are already wearing it well.

working.claim: The high-rise, wide-leg trousers with your shirt fully tucked give you a long, clean leg line.
working.evidence: High-waisted wide-leg tailored trousers at the natural waist, blouse fully tucked, full-length hem breaking over pointed boots; two records read torso_vs_legs as longer_legs; stated height 165 cm.
working.why: At 165 cm, a high rise plus a near-floor hem over a pointed toe adds visual height. Keep this cut in every trouser you buy.

face.shape: Oval, with rounded cheekbones that lift when you smile, a soft tapered chin and a medium-length neck. It is a balanced face that most necklines suit, so choose them for mood and occasion, not correction.

necklines.what: Open collars and soft V-necks, two buttons undone on shirts or a V-placket on a kurta
necklines.why: The open point collar you already wear frames your face well. A V adds a little length through your medium neck and points the eye up to your smile.
necklines.evidence: All three reads: oval face, medium/moderate neck length visible at the open collar of the magenta blouse

necklines.what: A sweetheart or deep U-neck on saree and lehenga blouses for weddings and festive events
necklines.why: The curve echoes your rounded cheekbones. It also opens the collarbone, which carries the golden highlights that make your skin glow.
necklines.evidence: Rounded cheekbones that lift when smiling; golden-brown highlights on forehead, cheeks and collarbone

necklines.what: A boat neck kept just below the collarbone, for formal work tops and festive blouses
necklines.why: It gives your shoulders a touch of width, which suits a slight frame. Your neck is long enough to carry the horizontal line without looking shortened.
necklines.evidence: Slight frame, balanced shoulders and hips; medium-length neck

necklines.what: Keep high, closed necklines like turtlenecks and high-neck blouses for cooler evenings, and pair them with hair worn back
necklines.why: On a medium neck, a closed high neck worn with long hair falling in front crowds the space around your face. Moving the hair back fixes that.
necklines.evidence: Medium-length neck; hair worn loose with front sections falling forward over both shoulders

collars.what: Point collars worn open, as on your magenta blouse
collars.why: This collar already works for you. It is crisp enough for formal work, and open it frames your face without adding bulk to your frame.
collars.evidence: Long-sleeve blouse with point collar, open at the neck, on an oval face and slight frame

collars.what: A mandarin or band collar on kurtas and work shirts, slim (2–3 cm high) and with a short slit at the front
collars.why: It is a clean, office-ready line that suits your neck length. The slit stops it from closing the neck in heat and humidity.
collars.evidence: Medium-length neck; stated climate hot and humid; office life

collars.what: Small to medium notch lapels on blazers and Nehru jackets
collars.why: Narrow-to-medium lapels stay in scale with a slight frame. Wide lapels would take over your shoulders.

glasses.what: If you wear frames for screens or sun, choose soft rectangles or gently upswept cat-eye shapes in medium-weight acetate, no wider than your face
glasses.why: An oval face carries most shapes. A slight lift at the outer corner echoes how your cheekbones lift when you smile, and medium weight matches your defined brows without overpowering a slight frame.
glasses.evidence: No glasses worn; oval face; defined medium-thick dark brows; rounded cheekbones that lift when smiling

hair.what: Keep the long centre-parted waves with volume through the lengths. For formal work, add a low sleek bun or half-up style that pulls the front sections back off your shoulders.
hair.why: Loose waves frame your oval face beautifully and bring softness to a slight frame. Pulling the front pieces back shows the collar or neckline and reads more polished in the office and in heat.
hair.evidence: Long, wavy, very deep black-brown hair, centre parting, front sections falling over both shoulders, full volume through the lengths, smooth at the crown

earrings_or_scale.what: Size your everyday hoops up to medium (2.5–3.5 cm). For festive events, wear jhumkas or drops that end between your earlobe and jaw, not on your shoulder.
earrings_or_scale.why: Small hoops get lost behind your full, dark waves, and a medium size holds its own beside your hair. On a slight frame, drops that stop above the jaw keep the scale right and won't tangle with hair worn forward.
earrings_or_scale.evidence: Small (one read: medium) silver-toned hoops; full-volume long hair falling in front of both shoulders; slight frame

body.summary: At your stated 165 cm you have a slight, balanced frame, with shoulders and hips in line and legs that read slightly longer than your torso. That gives you an easy, elongated line that tailoring shows off.

silhouettes.evidence: Magenta blouse fully tucked into high-waisted wide-leg black trousers; one read notes the longer-leg look is helped by the high-rise waistband and tuck

silhouettes.what: A straight-cut kurta, fitted at the shoulder and easing over the hip, worn with straight pants or a narrow palazzo

silhouettes.why: A defined waist then volume below plays to your longer legs and shows the shape a slight frame can lose in loose layers.

rise_and_lengths.what: Wide-leg and palazzo hems should finish 1–2 cm off the floor in the shoe you will wear most with them
rise_and_lengths.why: Near-floor length gives your 165 cm a long, clean line. A hem that clears the floor stays crisp and doesn't pick up wet ground in a humid climate.
rise_and_lengths.evidence: Hem breaks over the boots, near floor length; stated height 165 cm; hot and humid climate

rise_and_lengths.what: Kurtas at the knee or just below, and tunics to mid-thigh over slim pants
rise_and_lengths.why: At 165 cm with longer legs, knee length balances your torso and leg. Calf-length kurtas can shorten you unless worn with a heel.
rise_and_lengths.evidence: Stated height 165 cm; torso vs legs longer legs

rise_and_lengths.what: Long sleeves ending at the wrist bone. In heat, choose three-quarter or elbow sleeves on kurtas and blouses.
rise_and_lengths.why: A clean sleeve finish keeps your hands and stacked rings on show. Shorter sleeves are cooler for daily office wear.
rise_and_lengths.evidence: Buttoned cuffs on long-sleeve blouse; stacked rings on right hand; hot and humid climate

print_scale.what: Small to medium prints and motifs, roughly coin- to palm-sized: fine bandhani, small block prints, delicate buttis, narrow stripes
print_scale.why: Your slight frame is best served by prints that stay in proportion. Large-scale florals or wide borders would take over your outfit.
print_scale.evidence: Slight frame; average height impression; stated height 165 cm

accessory_scale.what: Fine to medium pieces: a delicate chain or one medium pendant, a structured medium bag, and festive sets with one statement piece (earrings or necklace, not both oversized)
accessory_scale.why: The fine pieces you already wear suit your frame. A single step up in one piece adds presence without overwhelming you.
accessory_scale.evidence: Fine chain necklace, small hoops, stacked rings; slight frame

fabric_weight.what: Light to mid-weight fabrics that drape: cotton, linen-blend, viscose crepe and cotton-silk for work; georgette, chanderi, organza and light silk for festive; tropical-weight suiting for trousers
fabric_weight.why: Fluid, lighter fabrics follow a slight frame instead of standing away from it, and they breathe in heat. Satin-finish silks can show heat marks, so crepe de chine or cotton-silk keep the same sheen with more comfort.
fabric_weight.evidence: Silk/satin blouse with soft sheen drapes well; wool crepe trousers; slight frame; stated climate hot and humid

fit_fixes.what: Keep the blouse tuck to a light, even blouse of 1–2 cm. If shirts gather more than that, have the side seams taken in slightly below the bust.
fit_fixes.why: A neat, small blouse keeps your waist defined. Excess fabric at the tuck adds bulk your slight frame doesn't need.
fit_fixes.evidence: Fabric drapes and blouses slightly at the waist above the tuck

fit_fixes.what: Hem wide-leg trousers to your chosen shoe height and stick to that heel height with them, so the front just grazes the shoe
fit_fixes.why: A hem that pools over boots shortens the leg line you are building with the high rise.
fit_fixes.evidence: Full-length hem that breaks over/covers most of the boots

fit_fixes.what: Have kurta and blazer shoulder seams set at your shoulder point, and take in the side seams if the body swings loose
fit_fixes.why: Ready-made sizes often fit length but run wide on a slight frame. A tailored shoulder makes budget pieces in the 1,500–4,000 range look custom.
fit_fixes.evidence: Slight frame; balanced shoulders; stated budget per item 1,500 to 4,000

fit_fixes.what: Have festive blouses (saree and lehenga cholis) stitched to measure, with the waist darts and armhole fitted closely
fit_fixes.why: A precise blouse is what makes drape and flare look intentional on a slight frame.
fit_fixes.evidence: Slight frame; stated occasions weddings and festive

grooming.what: Keep the long, centre-parted soft waves. Use a light anti-humidity cream on the lengths and keep a sleek low bun as your formal-work alternative.
grooming.why: The waves frame your face and suit your frame. A humidity product keeps the definition crisp in your climate.
grooming.evidence: Long wavy very deep hair, centre part, defined waves from chin level, smooth at crown; stated climate hot and humid

grooming.what: Keep the defined brows and rosy-brown lip for daily wear. For festive events, switch to a clear raspberry or bright coral-pink lip.
grooming.why: Your natural look is polished and right for the office. A clear, brighter lip echoes how well the saturated magenta sits on you, ideal for celebrations.
grooming.evidence: Natural makeup, defined brows, rosy-brown lip; skin sits clearly against bright magenta #C21E6A without looking sallow

grooming.what: Keep your skin finish even and luminous. A lightweight gel moisturiser and SPF suit the heat, with a little blotting on the T-zone rather than heavy powder.
grooming.why: The golden sheen in daylight is an asset. Light layers protect it in humidity without dulling it.
grooming.evidence: Even skin; slight golden sheen on face and hands in daylight; stated climate hot and humid

grooming.what: Keep the silver-toned pieces and the ring stack, but size your earrings up to medium hoops so they show through your hair
grooming.why: The metal reads cleanly and crisp on you. The earrings are currently a step too small to compete with your full, dark waves.

stop_buying.item: Black trousers and suiting for hot office days
stop_buying.why: Heavy black wool takes the softness out of your bright colours and traps heat. Ink navy in crepe or linen-viscose gives you the same polish.

stop_buying.item: Muted, greyed colours like dusty mauve, muted olive khaki and greige taupe
stop_buying.why: Your colouring is clear and bright. These dull shades near your face drain the golden glow your magenta brings out.

stop_buying.item: Large, bold prints and heavy, stiff fabrics
stop_buying.why: Your slight, balanced frame suits coin- to palm-sized motifs and fabrics that drape. Big prints and heavy cloth swamp you.

filters: Keep clear, bright colour near your face, never dusty or greyed.
Default to ink navy, not black, for trousers and blazers.
Wear silver or gold freely, and mix them when you like.
Choose high-rise waists, with hems 1–2 cm off the floor.
Ask: does it feel polished, breezy and joyful at once?

summary.you_are: You're a bright spring with a slight frame, an oval face and long legs.
five_lines: Wear clear, saturated colour at your face. Skip anything dusty or greyed.
Swap black for ink navy. Silver and gold both work, polished only.
Tuck the top. Keep the trouser high-rise and wide, hem just off the floor.
Polished, breezy, joyful. Pressed lines in fabrics that breathe.
Find your wide-leg trouser in ink navy crepe. Try it with the magenta.

seen.lead: Three facts decide everything here. Your colouring is bright, your face is oval, and your frame is slight.
points: Your skin is golden-brown with a neutral undertone. Magenta sits clean against it.
Your hair is deep black-brown and your eyes are dark. Contrast is medium.
Your face is oval with rounded cheekbones that lift when you smile.
You are 165 cm, slight, with balanced shoulders and hips. Your legs read longer than your torso.
You wore a magenta silk blouse, tucked, with black wide-leg trousers, pointed boots and silver jewellery.
seen.detail: In daylight the magenta read a touch pinker in some shots. It stayed clear and never turned ashy.

colours.lead: Clear colours work on you. Dusty ones make you look tired.
points: Wear magenta, turquoise, emerald, cobalt and coral near your face. Marigold and coral red suit festive days.
Use ink navy, warm ivory and light camel as your base. Keep black below the waist.
Clarity is the rule you cannot bend. Greyed or muddy shades flatten you in any temperature.
Undertone is the one you can bend. Move between warm coral and cool sapphire, as long as the colour stays clear.
Skip dusty mauve, muted olive khaki and greige taupe. They drain your skin and dull your eyes.
colours.detail: Hold the fabric under your chin at a window. If the shadows under your jaw stay warm brown and your brows look sharper, buy it. If your skin looks dusty, put it back.

face.lead: Open the neckline. Your oval face suits almost every shape, so pick by mood.
points: Wear open collars and soft V-necks. Undo two buttons, or choose a V-placket kurta.
Choose a sweetheart or deep U-neck on saree and lehenga blouses.
Keep boat necks just below the collarbone for formal tops.
Wear high, closed necks only on cool evenings, with your hair pulled back.
Keep point collars open and use slim mandarin collars with a short slit on kurtas.
Choose small to medium notch lapels. Wide ones crowd your shoulders.
In glasses, pick soft rectangles or gently upswept cat-eyes. Keep them no wider than your face.
Keep the long centre-parted waves. For formal work, add a low sleek bun.
Size your hoops up to 2.5 to 3.5 cm. Wear jhumkas that end between lobe and jaw.
face.detail: An oval face is balanced, so you correct nothing. Your cheekbones lift when you smile, so curves and slight upsweeps echo them.

body.lead: Tuck the top. Keep the trouser high and wide. Your waist is the line to show.
points: Wear a tucked top with high-rise wide-leg trousers. For weddings, fit the bodice and start the flare at your waist.
Keep the rise at your natural waist. Finish wide hems 1 to 2 cm off the floor.
Wear kurtas at the knee or just below. Calf length shortens you without a heel.
Choose small to medium prints, coin to palm size. Skip big florals and wide borders.
Pick light, draping fabrics like cotton-silk, linen blends and crepe.
Keep the tuck neat at 1 to 2 cm. Take in the side seams if the shirt gathers more.
body.detail: At a stated 165 cm with longer legs, a high rise and a near-floor hem add height. A slight frame needs fabric that follows it and prints in proportion.

style.lead: You are Polished Ease, in three words: polished, breezy, joyful.
points: The pressed creases, the neat tuck and the pointed boots prove polished.
Keep the magenta silk, the black boots, the silver hoops, the chain and the stacked rings.
Retire the black wool-crepe trousers. They are too heavy for your heat.
style.detail: Check each piece against all three words. Polished means a crease or a clean tuck. Breezy means fabric that breathes in humidity. Joyful means clear colour you want near your face.

grooming.lead: Size your earrings up. Everything else stays.
points: Keep the long waves. Use a light anti-humidity cream on the lengths.
Keep the defined brows and rosy-brown lip. For festive days, wear a clear raspberry or coral-pink lip.
Use gel moisturiser and SPF. Blot the T-zone and skip heavy powder.
Wear medium hoops. Keep the silver chain and the ring stack.
grooming.detail: Your skin has a golden sheen in daylight. Light layers protect it in the heat.

verification.claim: Bright, clear colour at your face is already your strongest move. The magenta silk makes your skin look golden and alive.
The high-rise, wide-leg trousers with your shirt fully tucked give you a long, clean leg line.
Your long, centre-parted waves frame your oval face and soften the sharp tailoring.
